process.title: Bills I still have to pay
process.task: Find the emails that are bills or payment requests the person still has to pay. Receipts for things already paid don't count.

steps.question: Is this email about a specific amount of money the reader owes, has paid, or will be charged?

options.name: yes
options.meaning: it is a bill, invoice, payment reminder, receipt, charge notice or other request for money from the reader

options.name: no
options.meaning: newsletter, sale or advert, personal message, invitation, delivery update or account notice with no amount owed by the reader

then.target: not sure whether this email is about a payment

steps.question: Does the reader still have to pay this amount themselves?

options.name: still-to-pay
options.meaning: an open invoice, reminder or request where the reader must still pay or transfer the money

options.name: already-paid
options.meaning: a receipt or confirmation that the payment was already received

options.name: automatic
options.meaning: the amount will be charged automatically (subscription renewal, direct debit) and no action is needed

then.target: not sure whether this still has to be paid

steps.question: Does this payment request show signs of a scam, such as a sender address that imitates a known company, threats that the account or mail will be deleted, or pressure to verify identity and pay within hours?

options.name: yes
options.meaning: one or more of these warning signs appear in the sender or text

options.name: no
options.meaning: an ordinary bill or reminder from the company itself, with a normal due date and no threats

then.target: this payment request may be a scam — check before paying
not sure whether this payment request is genuine
